scientific_integrity: Exact all-size support reduction and symbolic coefficient collection; independently simulated all states for five small parameters; no independent mathematical audit or claim of established priority.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four states, threshold one, synchronous updates, friendship graphs. A finite exhaustive 4092-support computation is the nonstandard lemma; general cactus graphs and alternative thresholds are not covered. Historical priority is qualified by inaccessible full text and unindexed literature.
title: Four-color excitation on friendship graphs: uniform extinction and four limiting terminal shells
